description: NaLiMg₆O₇ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4mm space group. Na is bonded to five O atoms to form NaO₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one LiO₅ square pyramid, corners with four equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, and edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra. There is one shorter (2.13 Å) and four longer (2.18 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Li is bonded to five O atoms to form LiO₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, corners with four equivalent LiO₅ square pyramids, and edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra. There is one shorter (1.84 Å) and four longer (2.19 Å) Li-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent LiO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.17 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-8°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.17 Å. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.17 Å. In the fourth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent LiO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.35 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, and four equivalent Mg atoms to form ONaLiMg₄ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent ONaLiMg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°. In the second O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra and edges with eight OLi₂Mg₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the third O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaLiMg₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-3°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Li and four Mg atoms to form OLi₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six OLi₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with ten ONaLiMg₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-16°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Mg atoms to form ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six OLi₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with ten ONaLiMg₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°.
